theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U m) (W M : Set (Euclid P)) (k : ℤ) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → k ≠ 0 → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → IsOrientation m M ξ → closure M ∩ W ⊆ M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ W → T ω = k * ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]) → T.support ∩ W = M ∩ W
